items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: My mother bought a record of King Oliver playing with a team called Butterbeans and Susie... I used to just sit and listen to it all night.

ctx.x: The cornet, yeah. From then, I used to get... My mother bought all them records. See, she bought a record of King Oliver playing with a team called Butterbeans and Susie. I don't know whether you ever heard of them.

items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I'd never met them, you know.

ctx.x: Willis Young couldn't play as good as Lester Young, though.

Oh, no! Hell, no. Shit, he couldn't gooder than me! That's why he liked me so well. He said, "You blow just like Joe Oliver and Louis Armstrong" -- I'd never met them, you know. He said, "You got a lot of power." He said, "They have power. Now, if you was in New Orleans on one of them parades, they would like you, because you blow loud and strong." I said, "Thank you."
